verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations that do not meet business requirements, so authorization-time restriction is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never says these rules can target merchant category codes or individual merchants. Relayed authorisation lets a developer build custom decline logic on their own servers, but that is a building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented MCC allowlist and blocklist criteria in transaction rules, single-merchant lock support, ops-facing configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can restrict where a card works — merchant category (MCC) allowlists and blocklists, and single-merchant locks — applied at authorization time

citations.quote: You can use transaction rules to configure a logic that automatically declines an authorization that does not meet your business' requirements.
Create transaction rules to automatically approve or decline authorizations.
